summary: Strong reviews and a central Abu Dhabi office are strengths, but unrelated betting content, a test link and a booking section with no form appear to put your reputation and enquiries at risk.

findings.problem: Promotional lines for online casino and betting sites in several languages appear on the page, with links named test2, which suggests the site may have been compromised.
findings.cost: Clients and search engines may treat the site as unsafe, which hurts trust and ranking.
findings.fix: A security clean up, hardened hosting and monitoring.

findings.problem: The Book a Call section shows only the link text test2, with no form or booking tool, and a WhatsApp us heading has no number under it.
findings.cost: Clients who want to call or message first cannot, and enquiries are lost.
findings.fix: A working booking form and a WhatsApp button.

findings.problem: The footer number +971 505809025 links to a different number, tel:+971 26777763, and the firm appears under three different names.
findings.cost: A client who taps to call may reach a different line and trust drops.
findings.fix: One checked number and one firm name.

findings.problem: The page claims #1 law firm in Abu Dhabi with no source, shows 36 reviews but displays eight, and contains typos such as 'high standers'.
findings.cost: Unsourced rankings and typos weaken a law firm.
findings.fix: Sourced credentials, a full review wall and proofread copy.

redesign: A clean, secured site with monitoring.
A booking form and WhatsApp with one checked phone number.
Sourced credentials, named lawyers and proofread copy.
